newsitem.title: USA: Templeton fund rejects bid to be open-ended.
newsitem.headline: Templeton fund rejects bid to be open-ended.

text.p: Templeton Global Governments Income Trust said that its shareholders rejected a proposal to convert the closed-end mutual fund into an open-end investment company.
The fund's annual meeting will be reconvened on Tuesday, April 1, 1997, at 1000 EST in Fort Lauderdale, Fla., for final tabulation of shareholder votes, Templeton Global said.

Because the mailing of the Trust's supplemental proxy materials to some shareholders by an unrelated proxy distribution firm was later than anticipated, final tabulation of the shareholder vote was postponed for one week, Templeton Global said. This will allow additional time for all shareholders to exercise their vote, the fund said.
